name: Nijou
source:
Far East Branch Staff. He is ble to handle a wide range of tasks, from annihilating resistance forces to paperwork. He excels in both literary and military arts, and stands out among ordinary employees.

He doesn't show much emotion. Hhe calmly carries out his duties, and also calmly eats sweets.

He vowed to dedicate his "life, body, and soul" to Yuni.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/raid/character_detail.html#nijo]official website[/url]]
